channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Renan Santos: o outsider candidato à Presidência - O Assunto #1766
item.description: Renan Santos, founder of the MBL, was officially nominated as the presidential candidate for the Missão party, formed in 2025 from the movement. His government plan proposes 'favelization eradication', war on organized crime, municipal mergers, and ending Bolsa Família, inspired by Javier Milei and Nayib Bukele. The candidacy positions him as an anti-Lula and anti-Flávio Bolsonaro outsider in the 2026 political landscape.

item.title: Aliados apontam razões que podem fazer Cleitinho recuar de candidatura
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) remains undecided about running for governor of Minas Gerais, despite polling around 30% in voter intentions and support from allies like Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). While allies highlight his strong grassroots appeal in the state’s interior, they cite personal concerns and political controversies — including alleged ties to a land conflict killing in Amazonas involving his Senate alternate and corruption allegations against Republicanos state leader Euclydes Pettersen — as factors that may lead him to withdraw.

item.title: Redes de la nueva derecha entre Europa y América Latina
item.description: The victory of far-right candidates in countries like Colombia and Argentina, combined with Trump's influence on Latin American elections and the presidential race in Brazil between Lula and Bolsonaro, suggests a deeper ideological shift beyond mere protest voting. The article argues that understanding the structure, ideology, and organization of these new right-wing forces is essential for progressives to develop effective counter-strategies.

item.title: Soberania nacional não se improvisa
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he does not want war nor to be caught off guard, emphasizing the importance of national preparedness. His remark raises the enduring question of why states invest in military capabilities that may never be used, a core dilemma in the formation of modern states.

item.title: A três dias de lançar candidatura, Flávio Bolsonaro está atrasado
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is lagging in his campaign preparations, with just three days left before the official launch of his candidacy. He has not yet selected a running mate and remains uncertain about which parties will support him. This situation raises doubts about the structure and viability of his electoral campaign.

item.title: De Lisboa a Pyongyang: onde estão os brasileiros aptos a votar no exterior
item.description: The Brazilian electorate abroad grew 31.8% since 2022, reaching 918,9 thousand voters, driven mainly by immigration to Portugal and the United States. Lisbon led the growth with a 74.1% increase, reaching 78.8 thousand voters, while the U.S. remains the country with the highest number of registered Brazilian voters (265.4 thousand). The top ten voting locations concentrate 46.2% of the overseas electorate, reflecting high concentration in a few key destinations.

item.title: Tarifaço de 25% sobre produtos brasileiros entra em vigor hoje nos EUA: entenda o que muda para os exportadores
item.description: The United States has imposed a 25% additional tariff on part of Brazilian exports, affecting sectors such as wood, furniture, machinery, footwear, ceramics, and sugar, with an estimated impact of $5.8 billion. Despite the measure, key products like oil, beef, aircraft, pulp, and coffee were excluded, and the Lula government is negotiating to mitigate the effects, including a possible additional 12.5% tariff linked to forced labor allegations.

item.title: Tarifaço: por que o Brasil evita uma retaliação imediata — e como pode responder aos EUA
item.description: The Lula government chose not to immediately retaliate against the U.S. 25% tariff on certain Brazilian exports, aiming to avoid giving political ammunition to Trump and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of elections. Instead, it is pursuing diplomatic negotiations and expanding exemption lists, while keeping the Economic Reciprocity Law as a future option.

item.title: Brasil opta por la cautela para responder a los nuevos aranceles impuestos por Estados Unidos
item.description: Brazil has adopted a cautious stance in response to the new 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian imports, despite initially threatening retaliation under its reciprocity law. Vice President Geraldo Alckmin warned that symmetrical retaliation would lead to mutual harm, citing the metaphor 'an eye for an eye and we will end up blind'. So far, Brasília has not activated concrete retaliatory measures.

item.title: Vereadora do PT diz que Tarcísio promove “desmonte” em SP
item.description: São Paulo city councilwoman Luna Zarattini (PT-SP) accused Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) of promoting a "dismantling" of public education in the state, citing deteriorating school infrastructure, teacher burnout due to digital platform policies, and failures in sanitation and transport. She also criticized the privatization of Sabesp and concessions in metropolitan trains and subways, attacked the Bolsonaro family over the Master case, and endorsed Fernando Haddad as a strong candidate to defeat Bolsonarism in São Paulo.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus mostra disputa Lula x Flávio após tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll, to be released on July 27, will assess the impact of the U.S. tariffs on Brazil on voter intentions for the 2026 presidential election. The survey will measure the contest between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), along with other candidates, and analyze how the trade crisis influences voter perceptions of the two main contenders, including whom they believe is right in the dispute.

item.title: Republicanos perde ação contra boneco de urna eletrônica e Parada LGBT
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) dismissed a lawsuit filed by the Republicans party against APOLGBT-SP and the Instituto Plena Cidadania for alleged premature electoral propaganda, ruling that banners and the inflatable 'Votinho' urn with slogans like 'Vote LGBT 2026' and 'The Street Calls, the Ballot Confirms' constitute generic calls for political participation, not targeted endorsements. The judge emphasized the absence of an explicit vote request, which is necessary to characterize premature electoral propaganda. The 30th São Paulo LGBT+ Pride Parade took place without the attendance of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas or Mayor Ricardo Nunes.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro rebate Caiado e direita fica mais rachada
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro countered Ronaldo Caiado's criticism of his U.S. green card, accusing the former governor of staying silent on January 8 convictions and using Goiás citizenship to favor STF allies. The exchange, including Caiado's Disney-themed poll as an indirect jab, deepens divisions on the Brazilian right and undermines prospects for a Caiado-Flávio Bolsonaro alliance in a potential 2026 runoff.

item.title: Tereza Cristina rejeita, Daniella Marques traz dificuldade. O que sobra para vice de Flávio? O desespero
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has yet to finalize his vice-presidential pick for the 2026 elections, despite the PL convention scheduled for March 25. Senator Tereza Cristina has been ruled out as an option, while economist Daniella Marques of the Republicans remains the favorite, contingent on a PL-Republicans coalition that has not yet materialized. The campaign is struggling to close the ticket, with the vice-presidential decision potentially delayed until the following weeks, within the legal timeframe.

item.title: Em evento com diplomatas, Flávio questiona segurança das urnas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro questioned the security of Brazil's electronic voting machines at a diplomatic event, citing CIA reports on Venezuela and claiming that Smartmatic machines used in Venezuela are also used in Brazil. The TSE denied the claims, stating Smartmatic has never supplied or accessed Brazilian voting machines or software, only providing technical training in 2020 and losing a bid to Positivo. Flávio clarified he does not question the voting process itself and urged more international observers to enhance election transparency.

item.title: Caiado rebate Eduardo Bolsonaro citando personagens da Disney: ‘Pateta da política brasileira’
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado provoked Eduardo Bolsonaro on social media by comparing him to the 'Goofy of Brazilian politics', suggesting his actions in the U.S. harm Brazil's economy. The exchange followed the revelation of a green card granted by Donald Trump to Eduardo Bolsonaro and his family, which sparked mutual criticism. Caiado accused Eduardo of damaging Brazil-U.S. relations, while Eduardo countered by accusing Caiado of staying silent on those convicted in the January 8 coup attempt and seeking favor with Brasilia's elite and the STF.

item.title: A disparada de Renan, o alerta para Zema e outras movimentações na pesquisa Real Time Big Data
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows Renan Santos at 9% in first-round voting intentions, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado (7%), highlighting his growth as an alternative to Lula-Bolsonaro polarization. While Renan rises, Romeu Zema loses traction on the right, with voters shifting to Caiado and Renan. Flávio Bolsonaro recovers in the runoff scenario, tying technically with Lula (42% to 45%) after a prior streak of declining polls.

item.title: Após citar dado falso sobre urna a diplomatas, Flávio diz que 'não coloca em dúvida o processo eleitoral brasileiro'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro denied having questioned the Brazilian electoral process after citing false information about the origin of electronic voting machines at an event with foreign diplomats. He stated that inviting international observers strengthens transparency, despite having referenced discredited claims about the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, which the TSE has refuted. The remarks were made during the 'Debating Brazil' event attended by diplomats from 42 countries.

item.title: Coordenador da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Michelle segue candidata
item.description: The coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, Senator Rogério Marinho, stated that the PL party continues to support Michelle Bolsonaro as its Senate pre-candidate for the Federal District, despite her recent absence following claims of mistreatment by her stepson. The statement aims to stabilize her candidacy amid speculation about her potential withdrawal from the race.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha pede apuração sobre vazamento de conversa
item.description: The defense of businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger has requested the Federal Supreme Court to investigate a possible leak of private conversations with Lulinha, son of former President Lula, intended for use in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign. The request follows an O Globo report indicating that Bolsonaro’s campaign planned to release audio related to the INSS fraud investigation. The defense claims no judicial authorization was granted for the interception and seeks access to the materials or an investigation into illegal breach of privacy.

item.title: Cacique ‘sincerão’: relembre seis declarações polêmicas de Valdemar Costa Neto, presidente do PL
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, reiterated controversial statements by claiming Flávio Bolsonaro was unprepared for a presidential run and needed Michelle Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Nikolas Ferreira on the front lines to win. He also defended the practice of party leaders directing parliamentary amendments without holding elected office, prompting criticism and a formal inquiry from Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino. These remarks underscore his reputation for blunt speech and are causing friction within and beyond the Bolsonarist base.

item.title: PSDB contesta Valdemar no STF e diz que desconhece indicação de emendas pela presidência do partido
item.description: The PSDB informed the STF that it has no knowledge of any quota, management, or distribution of parliamentary amendments by its presidency, in response to a determination by Minister Flávio Dino following the asset freeze of Valdemar Costa Neto (PL) and Eduardo Cunha. The freeze stems from Operation Transparency by the PF, which investigates a scheme directing parliamentary amendments through unelected individuals. Dino requested clarifications from all parties with congressional representation after Valdemar claimed such interference by party leaders is 'natural'.

item.title: MDB nega ao STF ter cota ou gestão de emendas parlamentares
item.description: The MDB informed the STF that it does not have quotas, reserves, or any mechanism for managing parliamentary amendments, stating that the definition of their allocation belongs exclusively to parliamentarians and legally authorized bodies. The statement was made in response to a determination by Minister Flávio Dino, following remarks by PL president Valdemar Costa Neto about partisan interference in amendments. The party emphasized there is no legal basis attributing authority over amendment allocation to its national presidency.

item.title: 🟢TERÇA PROFÉTICA | NÁRNIA PÓS COPA E AS ELEIÇÕES PRESIDENCIAIS | APÓSTOLO EDILSON POMINI 21/07/2026
item.description: The video titled 'Prophetic Tuesday: Nárnia Post-World Cup and the Presidential Elections', presented by Apostle Edilson Pomini on July 21, 2026, discusses a prophetic interpretation of Brazil's political landscape after the World Cup, linking symbolic events to the 2026 elections. No specific candidates are named, but the tone suggests a critical or警示 (warning) view of the country's political future, focusing on themes like corruption and social transformation. The content blends religious elements with political analysis, characteristic of prophetic discourse in electoral contexts.

item.title: Movimentos sociais vão aos EUA pedir respeito às eleições
item.description: Representatives from fifteen Brazilian civil society organizations met with U.S. lawmakers in Washington to seek international commitments against external interference in Brazil's 2026 elections. The delegation, led by the Washington Brazil Office, aims to safeguard the integrity of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: PL confirma convite para Michelle Bolsonaro disputar o Senado pelo DF
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) pre-campaign, confirmed that the PL party continues to count on Michelle Bolsonaro as its Senate candidate for the Federal District in 2026. He stated she was officially invited, that the party is interested in her candidacy, and that, as of now, she remains the party's Senate nominee.

item.title: Marinho minimiza fala de Valdemar sobre Flávio: “Candidato era Jair”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign coordinator, Rogério Marinho, downplayed Valdemar Costa Neto’s comments, saying they were taken out of context and that Flávio was chosen as candidate after Jair Bolsonaro’s ineligibility. Marinho stated that Flávio is now a competitive and solid candidate, with the PL expanding its regional alliances from 10 to about 20 state-level palanques and securing roughly one-third of the electorate, ensuring a place in the runoff.

item.title: Parlamento da Nicarágua inicia plano para frear oposição no país
item.description: Nicaragua's National Assembly has begun analyzing measures proposed by President Daniel Ortega to suppress opposition, including special sessions with the Supreme Electoral Council as a foundation for institutional reforms. Ortega previously decreed the end of elections to prevent opposition figures, many in exile, from regaining power. The government frames the move as necessary for peace and stability, but the international community views it as a deepening of authoritarian rule and dictatorship.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede observadores estrangeiros na eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) requested that diplomats from 42 countries send international observers to Brazil's October presidential election. During a meeting in Brasília, he linked Brazil's electronic voting machines to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic, repeating claims already refuted by the Superior Electoral Court.

item.title: Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro são os mais rejeitados no PI, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former President Jair Bolsonaro are the most rejected political figures in Piauí, with 57.5% and 56.5% rejection rates, respectively, according to an AtlasIntel/Meio Norte poll released on July 21, 2026. The survey, conducted among 1,188 voters from July 15–20, places Ciro Nogueira third at 47.2% and Lula ninth at 21.6%. The poll has a 95% confidence level and a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Em meio à treta com Eduardo, Caiado usa Disney e ironiza: "Pateta"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado mocked Eduardo Bolsonaro by comparing him to Disney's Goofy, suggesting he is clumsy and harms Brazilian interests in the U.S. The exchange began after Caiado criticized Eduardo's green card, arguing it should benefit Brazilian farmers and industry, not personal gain. Eduardo retaliated, accusing Caiado of staying silent on ruralists convicted for the January 8 attacks and of attending elitist gatherings with the STF and Brasília's elite.

item.title: Caiado ironiza o “Pateta” da “política brasileira”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, former governor of Goiás and presidential pre-candidate, used the Disney character Goofy as an analogy to criticize Eduardo Bolsonaro’s statements made in the United States, implying the deputy speaks clumsily and makes mistakes. The remark was made during a political event and echoed by media outlets.

item.title: Renan Santos atinge 10% nas pesquisas, mas propostas heterodoxas geram debate
item.description: Renan Santos, MBL coordinator, reached 10% voter intention in recent polls, but his government plan is facing criticism for proposing heterodox and eccentric measures. The rise in popularity contrasts with the debate sparked by proposals outside traditional political consensus.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: Lula avalia não ir aos debates do 1º turno para evitar ataques
item.description: Former Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is considering skipping the first-round debates of the 2026 elections to avoid direct confrontations with his opponents and minimize personal attacks during the campaign. The strategy would focus on controlled appearances and communication via social media and closed events, aiming to preserve his image and avoid wear in a highly polarized political landscape.

item.title: Em reunião com diplomatas, Flavio Bolsonaro ataca urnas eletrônicas com acusações já desmentidas pelo TSE
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, repeated discredited claims by the TSE against Brazil's electronic voting machines, alleging ties to the Venezuelan company Smartmatic and citing an alleged CIA report on election fraud in Venezuela. Despite stating he was not questioning Brazil's voting system, he called for more foreign election observers in the 2026 elections. The remarks were made during the 'Debating Brazil' event with representatives from nearly 50 countries.

item.title: Governo aguarda definição dos EUA sobre tarifa adicional
item.description: The Brazilian government is awaiting a U.S. decision on a potential additional 12.5% tariff on Brazilian products, on top of a 25% tariff set to take effect on July 22. The outcome, expected by July 24, could alter Brazil’s export scenario and guide executive actions, including diplomatic negotiations and market diversification efforts, such as an upcoming official mission to India. Officials called the U.S. measure unjust but emphasized continued dialogue with productive sectors and evaluation of proposals to mitigate economic impacts.

item.title: Biden brasileiro? Aliados de Lula avaliam proibir petista de participar de debates
item.description: Allies of the Lula government are considering banning the president from participating in televised debates during the first round of the 2026 elections, aiming to preserve his image and prioritize grassroots agendas. The proposal comes from government strategists and advisors aligned with the PT’s pragmatic wing, which views the debate marathon as a risky endeavor. The goal is to avoid exposure that could wear down the candidate against opponents.

item.title: Dino manda notificar estados e municípios que não prestaram contas de ’emendas Pix’
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino has ordered the direct notification of states and municipalities that failed to account for 'Pix amendments' allocated to the events sector between 2020 and 2024, imposing a daily fine of 1% of the transferred amount on entities violating transparency rules. The measure aims to enforce penalties for omissions or incomplete submission of Work Plans and Management Reports in the Transferegov.br system, based on AGU data showing 21 plans without reports, 19 with partial reports, 40 in completion phase without registration, and 9 with inconsistent or incomplete documentation.

item.title: Material de campanha impresso para pleito majoritário também deve ser produzido em Braille
item.description: The TSE has released the percentages of voters with visual impairments by state, which will serve as the basis for applying the rule requiring printed campaign material to also be produced in Braille for the 2026 majoritarian elections. The rule, established under TSE Resolution No. 23.610/2019, mandates that parties, federations, and candidates produce flyers and pamphlets in Braille proportional to the number of visually impaired voters in each electoral district, covering president, governor, and senator races. Tocantins has the highest percentage (0.33%), while Goiás, Santa Catarina, and São Paulo have the lowest (0.16%); in absolute numbers, São Paulo leads with 53,192 visually impaired voters.

item.title: Eduardo diz que vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio “demonstra imaturidade”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro called Michelle Bolsonaro's video criticizing Flavio Bolsonaro and PL party deals an act of 'immaturity,' stating that internal disputes over presidential candidacy are natural but should remain private. He added the incident reflects right-wing mobilization and hope for a more conservative election, but such matters should be resolved internally.

item.title: Flávio cita informação falsa sobre empresa venezuelana e urnas ao pedir a diplomatas que enviem 'observadores' ao Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged foreign diplomats to send election observers to Brazil's 2026 elections, citing false claims about Venezuelan company Smartmatic interfering in Brazil's electronic voting system. He referenced CIA documents released under the Trump administration, which do not confirm large-scale electronic fraud in Venezuela, to support his request. The remarks were made at the 'Debating Brazil' event in Brasília, attended by representatives from 42 countries.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG sobre a disputa pela Presidência
item.description: The Nexus institute released a new presidential voting intention poll for 2026, commissioned by BTG Pactual, based on 2,000 interviews with a two-point margin of error. In the previous round (July 13), Lula led with 40%, six points ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (34%), while Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado trailed. The poll will also measure approval of Lula’s government and voter reaction to the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian imports.

item.title: “Se não me demitir, o demitido é ele”, diz Eduardo sobre ministro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro, former federal deputy and son of ex-President Jair Bolsonaro, warned that Justice Minister Wellington César Lima e Silva risks being dismissed if he does not approve the PF’s recommendation to fire Eduardo for abandonment of duty. Living in the U.S. since February 2025 with a green card granted by Trump, Eduardo claims he is fleeing political persecution but wishes to return to Brazil when conditions allow.

item.title: Em encontro com embaixadores, Flávio resgata episódio que tornou Bolsonaro inelegível e diz que pai 'apenas manifestava preocupações' com sistema eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) recalled in English, during a meeting with ambassadors, that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, was declared ineligible for having held a similar meeting in 2022, where he raised unfounded suspicions about Brazil's electronic voting system. He corrected his statement, clarifying that the former president is ineligible — not imprisoned — due to the abusive use of state structure and TV Brasil to spread electoral disinformation before foreign diplomats. Flávio stated he does not question Brazil's electronic voting machines but advocates for greater international observer presence in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: candidatos a presidente poderão gastar até R$ 133,4 milhões em campanha, define TSE
item.description: The TSE set spending limits for the 2026 elections, maintaining the same values as in 2022. Presidential candidates may spend up to R$ 88.9 million in the first round and an additional R$ 44.5 million if there is a runoff, totaling R$ 133.4 million. Limits vary by office and state, based on the R$ 4.9 billion Campaign Finance Special Fund and Election Law.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leva informações falsas sobre urnas em reunião com embaixadores e repete o pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) spread false information about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors in Brasília, repeating claims previously made by his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, who was convicted in a coup plot. The incident occurred on Tuesday (21st) and reignites concerns about electoral misinformation in Brazil.

item.title: Escritório de gestão da mudança amplia engajamento em 73%
item.description: The implementation of a Change Management Office (CMO) by a Brazilian energy company, in partnership with SMR Consultoria from November 2025 to April 2026, increased employee engagement by 73% through a structured methodology (RUMOS) that integrated change management into project governance. Involving 12 areas and approximately 100 professionals, the initiative standardized communication, training, leadership support, and risk monitoring, enabling knowledge transfer across transformation initiatives.

item.title: Javier Milei deve discursar em evento que lançará Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência, diz Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho stated that Argentine President Javier Milei is expected to speak at the event launching Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy, scheduled for Saturday in São Paulo. The PL party is seeking alliances with PP, União Brasil, and Republicanos to strengthen the ticket, though no vice-presidential candidate has been named yet, with a decision expected by August 5. Marinho also noted that Flávio Bolsonaro was not previously prepared for a presidential run, but the campaign is now gaining organizational traction.

item.title: Por que Tereza Cristina recusou a ideia de ser vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) declined the invitation to be Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) running mate in the 2026 presidential election, stating she intends to run for Senate President in 2027. She aims to succeed Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), the current Senate President, after distinguishing herself in opposition to Lula's government, notably in the rejection of Jorge Messias to the STF.

item.title: Partido Comunista é suspenso pelo TRE-DF e pode ficar fora das eleições
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of the Federal District (TRE-DF) suspended the regional directory of the Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) due to non-compliance with the 2023 financial reporting, blocking access to party and electoral funds and preventing the party from nominating candidates in the 2026 elections if the suspension remains in effect at the time of the party convention.
